statements.proposition: The EPSS-score update to ~3,100 nuclei CVE templates is backward compatible with existing Nuclei workflows.
statements.label: CANNOT_TELL
statements.note: Impact claim. Visible changes are mostly epss-score/epss-percentile metadata lines, which is consistent with compatibility, but the change list is truncated at 3000 of 3099 files and some files also have non-EPSS line rewrites (paired identical-looking -/+ lines, e.g. 'part: body', 'matchers-condition: and'), so no concrete check settles it; I did not run nuclei over the templates.
evidence: gh api pulls/12521: changed_files=3099, additions=6547, deletions=6091; paginated file list returned 3000 entries, all status modified

patch lines that are not epss-score/epss-percentile include paired removed/added lines such as '- part: body' / '+ part: body' (9 each) and '- matchers-condition: and' / '+ matchers-condition: and' (6 each)
